# Source: order fulfilment at a bicycle wholesaler (interview notes)

A customer order arrives by email. A sales employee enters the order into the ERP.
Credit control checks the customer's credit limit. If the limit is exceeded, the sales
manager decides whether to accept the order anyway; a rejected order is closed and the
customer is told.

For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
The carrier collects the parcel and delivers it to the customer. After shipment the ERP
generates and sends the invoice automatically.

The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.

Returns are handled by a separate process that is not described here.
